title: Refresh: Study Session
description: Join us to destress & study before finals + get an inside scoop into our winter board recruiting

title: Spaces: AI A Friend, A For, or ...Just There?
description:
Something new is starting at DePaul!! DePaul AI Spaces is having its first meeting this Wednesday, April 15th from 4–6 PM in Arts & Letters Room 305.
Whether you think AI is a friend, a foe, or just kind of... there — this is your space to talk about it. No experience needed, just curiosity. Come as you are!

title: Spaces: Can You Spot the AI
description:
DePaul AI is back with Spaces #2, with food!
this time we’re playing a little game, testing your eye,
and getting into why it’s becoming harder and harder to tell what’s real and what isn’t.

title: Tinkering: Your AI, Your Rules
description:
DePaul AI Tinkerings is here and for our first session we're running AI locally, right on your own laptop.
No big tech servers, no data in the cloud, no energy wasted on someone else's infrastructure.
Just you, your machine, and full control over what you're running.

title: Finale: AI & The Environment, Innovation at What Cost
description:
Join DePaul AI for an outdoor conversation on AI and sustainability!!
We’ll be discussing the environmental impact of AI through interactive activities, open discussion, and picnic-style hangouts at Vinny Circle.
